CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: feat(bytes): real second core-language base type (compiler + runtime + stdlib/bytes.prn), closing the embedded-NUL gap SPI/I2C named same day. Vec's own (Raw T) design found non-compiling/stale during investigation -- Bytes shipped as a small, non-generic addition instead. 18 real assertions (make test-bytes), 347/347 full suite. Real symbol-collision bug found+fixed live. Retrofitting spi/i2c/serial onto it not done yet. Apple #18637. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
